## JustMic 1.4.0

- Three built-in UI skins: Classic Rack keeps the original hardware interface; Canvas brings sidebar navigation, flat cards and fader-style controls; Midnight brings a tabbed studio workspace, a left-hand master and rounded rotary controls.
- Choose your layout using visual preview cards in Settings > Appearance. The choice is saved for the next launch; Restart to apply skin offers a safe, explicit restart. Dark/light colors remain independently adjustable.
- All skins use the same controls, commands and audio engine. Microphone effects, dials, presets, monitoring, soundboard tools, calibration and hotkeys retain their functionality.
- Skin restarts save settings first and refuse to interrupt recordings, sound imports, updates, setup, backups or open sound editors. Restarting briefly interrupts audio; your presets and sound copies are preserved.
- Existing installations stay on Classic Rack until you choose another skin. Unknown saved skin IDs safely fall back to Classic Rack.
- Classic Rack now lets expanded advanced controls grow its scrollable area instead of clipping them. Wide Canvas and Midnight sections arrange three modules side by side.
- Restart safety also keeps capped or unsuccessfully saved recordings available for an explicit save/retry instead of replacing them.

HEAR ME and PAUSE FOR SHARING behave as in 1.3.2: sharing pause is manual, not automatic screen-sharing detection.
